pages.text: $(bold)Lightning Manipulation$(): thunder roars, and only I command it.$(br2)$(bold)Forward$(): a $(bold)lightning bolt$() strikes the target in your sight — purely a visual effect (it deals no vanilla lightning damage and triggers no transformations such as pig → zombified piglin); the real damage is settled as $(bold)cursed damage$(): shared damage base × 80%, applying staff amplification and cursed energy core material traits, ignoring invulnerability frames. Casting cost follows the standard formula (1 - Affinity/100) × (10 + Output × 5).

$(bold)Reversal · Technique Release "Mythical Beast Amber"$(): press the reversal key (F) to switch it on, and press it again to switch it off.$(li)while active, $(bold)every melee or ranged hit$() you land (including projectiles such as arrows) carries extra $(bold)cursed lightning$(): +round((1 + Affinity/100) × (5 + Output × 5)), with electric sparks bursting at the point of impact$(li)constant drain per tick: cursed energy ceil(max(1, (1 - Affinity/100) × (2 + Output))) and health (0.15 + Output × 0.05)$(li)when either your cursed energy or your health (which cannot drop below 1 point) runs out, it $(bold)deactivates automatically$(); logging out or dying also turns it off$(br2)With high Output but low Affinity the release hits hard yet burns health and cursed energy at a terrifying rate — it suits short bursts, so remember to switch it off.
